title: A resolved case closes after the confirmation window and stays immutable
risk: Cases stay open forever, or a closed case is edited so the audit trail no longer reflects what the customer was told.
preconditions: A RESOLVED case CASE-T1-0006 for cust-a resolved at 2026-01-16T09:10:00Z in namespace cd-close-*

steps.action: Close the resolved case after the confirmation window
